arimoclomol.limitation: Arithmetic estimate using approximate plasma binding; serum concentrations are NPC population means, not patient-specific free tissue PK. SD is not a confidence interval.

azithromycin.limitation: Different cell systems and exposure durations; no inferred free cytosolic exposure or clinical readthrough.

scientific_claims.title: A flow cytometry-based reporter assay identifies macrolide antibiotics as nonsense mutation read-through agents.
scientific_claims.supported_claim: Fig 2B: APC(R1450X) reporter 100 microgram/mL for 48 hours. Fig 5A: RTT MeCP2(R294X) protein signal at 0.1 microgram/mL for 7 days. Nominal concentration ratio 1000.
scientific_claims.limitations: Different systems/endpoints. SMN1-deleted/SMN2-copy Fig 5C is not a defined nonsense-allele rescue assay; its low-dose labels differ 0.1/0.01. No BUB1B readthrough or functional rescue shown.

scientific_claims.title: The heat-shock response co-inducer arimoclomol protects against retinal degeneration in rhodopsin retinitis pigmentosa.
scientific_claims.supported_claim: Arimoclomol 1 micromolar for 24 hours in mutant-opsin SK-N-SH cells increased Hsp70 and reduced aggregation; discussion explicitly reports no improved mutant trafficking.
scientific_claims.limitations: Analogous misfolded protein; lower aggregation can reflect disposal. Does not establish useful mutant BubR1 stabilization or HSP90-dependent rescue.

scientific_claims.title: HSP90 inhibitors reduce cholesterol storage in Niemann-Pick type C1 mutant fibroblasts.
scientific_claims.supported_claim: In NPC1-I1061T fibroblasts, arimoclomol did not correct cholesterol storage across tested exposures; body describes 1.6–500 micromolar for 3/5 days. HSP70 blots at 50/400 micromolar were negative.
scientific_claims.limitations: Cell/context-specific counterevidence. Does not refute NPC clinical approval or prove lack of effect in BUB1B cells.

scientific_claims.title: Niacin Cures Systemic NAD+ Deficiency and Improves Muscle Performance in Adult-Onset Mitochondrial Myopathy.
scientific_claims.supported_claim: Adult-onset mitochondrial-myopathy niacin study reports increased blood/muscle NAD and muscle endpoints. This is a niacin-to-NAD bridge in another disease.
scientific_claims.limitations: No BUB1B/SIRT2 functional rescue or pediatric MVA regimen. Full formulation/methods not independently verified here. Linked erratum 32640244 exists; its text remains inaccessible and its effect is unverified.

scientific_claims.title: SIRT2 induces the checkpoint kinase BubR1 to increase lifespan.
scientific_claims.supported_claim: Abstract separates SIRT2 overexpression-mediated hypomorph lifespan benefit from NMN-mediated BubR1 abundance. K668 deacetylation is the proposed stability link.
scientific_claims.limitations: Neither niacin nor NMN lifespan treatment efficacy is established by this abstract. PMC API returned front/abstract without body; no figure-level quantitative lifespan claim independently verified.

scientific_claims.title: Deacetylation of the mitotic checkpoint protein BubR1 at lysine 250 by SIRT2 and subsequent effects on BubR1 degradation during the prometaphase/anaphase transition.
scientific_claims.supported_claim: SIRT2 deacetylates BubR1 K250; knockdown increased acetylation but did not substantially raise total BubR1 or delay prometaphase-to-anaphase transition in that study.
scientific_claims.limitations: Do not assume K250 deacetylation changes total protein or that NAD/SIRT2 enhancement has an invariably favorable checkpoint effect.

scientific_claims.title: Linking kinetochore attachment to checkpoint control: the role of Aurora B in BubR1 acetylation.
scientific_claims.supported_claim: Aurora B-dependent phosphorylation supports BubR1 K250acetylation, MCC/fibrous-corona maintenance and CENP-E-linked checkpoint control; acetylation-mimetic rescue is reported.
scientific_claims.limitations: This is a separate pathway constraint, not a niacin/SIRT2 drug experiment. Measure both K668andK250 and segregation function.

scientific_claims.title: SIRT1 and SIRT2 inhibition impairs pediatric soft tissue sarcoma growth.
scientific_claims.supported_claim: SIRT1/SIRT2 knockdown impaired RD rhabdomyosarcoma growth; tenovin-6 also reduced growth in the reported xenograft experiment.
scientific_claims.limitations: Does not demonstrate niacin-induced recurrence or imply the reverse intervention necessarily promotes tumors. It warrants an RMS counter-screen.

corrections.consequence: Do not assume correction is immaterial; exact methods/numerical efficacy remain qualified.
Visible author spellings differ; cannot independently certify that author names are the only correction.

CPIC_lead_name_query.conclusion: No lead-drug CPIC record matched the queried names; no actionable dose rule established for the seven observed markers.
